renderer: Compose ImageComposeScene, CPU offscreen, Geist, density 1

checks: Mixed checkbox activates once and becomes checked; native Space and disabled behavior
Radio arrows, Home, End, wrapping, disabled skipping, and one group tab stop
Choicebox has one whole-option native action for single and multiple selection
All 96 Check and 64 Radio variants remain within render bounds at text scales 1 and 2
All 20 Choicebox chrome variants and decorative slot colors
Long labels and descriptions retain whole words at text scale 2 in RTL
Neutral checked and mixed glyph pixels contrast in dark and increased-contrast dark modes

selectionSheets.focus: Third state block of each Check/Radio sheet

choiceboxSheets.decorativeSlot: A 24 dp circle demonstrates consumer-supplied content and the authored icon color role; it is not the Figma sample flash icon.

reviewedSourceCorrections.case: enabled selected or mixed neutral Check, excluding tiny
reviewedSourceCorrections.reason: The authored static white mark disappears on the light bg-inverted surface in dark mode. The inverse label role retains the selection mark in both themes.

runtimeExtensions: Unselected tiny controls retain keyboard focus paint although their authored focus frame is empty.
Choicebox receives a whole-option keyboard focus outline; its Figma family does not contain focus variants.
Choicebox row changes to a header plus full-width text when a word cannot fit beside the icon and indicator. The native action remains the same node.
Danger intent remains a semantic extension of the shared selection drawing; the authored Check and Radio families contain accent and neutral only.
preservedSourceDetails: Tiny is an unboxed 16 dp mark, not the smallest boxed control.
Radio large accent focus stroke is 5 dp; other large selected strokes are 6 dp.
Tiny neutral disabled Check keeps its authored static dark quaternary mark.
Choicebox card and row both reuse the large 20 dp Check or Radio indicator.
